reviews.text: Eddy was great! I needed him at the last minute and he was the perfect choice! Zero hassle, very efficient and caring with the dogs.

Walker Pack exceeded all my expectations. From the beginning, Edmarcelo demonstrated professionalism, commitment, and a special affection for dogs. My dog ​​loves the walks and is always happy and full of energy after returning home.

What I value most is the confidence he inspires. Knowing that my pet is being cared for by someone experienced, responsible, and passionate about animals makes all the difference.

Without a doubt, it was one of the best choices I made for my dog's quality of life. I wholeheartedly recommend them.

Very attentive to my daughter Pipoca, a 7-year-old cat who is afraid of everything and everyone, but Ed gained her trust. Nowadays she even asks to play with him and is very happy when he comes to take care of her.
I highly recommend him! He respects my cat's limits, plays with her and takes care of her as if she were his own!! ♥️😻
Eddy was super helpful and attentive from the very first contact! It's been over six months of daily walks with the dogs, and he's been completely punctual. Congratulations, I highly recommend him!

We hired Matilha Walker at a time when we needed help with our dog's routine, and it was a great choice. From the beginning, Edmarcelo was very attentive, seeking to understand her personality, habits, and needs.

Our dog adapted quickly and formed a bond of trust with him. The walks always respected her time and limits, which made all the difference.

In addition to the care and professionalism, we received photos and updates from the walks, which brought a lot of peace of mind. We are very grateful for the affection and dedication and wholeheartedly recommend Matilha Walker!

Edmarcelo is extremely professional. I had an excellent experience and I'm happy to recommend him! You can see the affection, dedication, and care he has for the animals. My pet was treated with a lot of love, attention, and responsibility, which made me feel very calm and safe. I highly recommend him! 🐶 …

When we think of Edmarcelo, the first word that comes to mind is trust. He's been taking care of our dog for years and we've never had a single worry. He's always been there when we need him, whether for daily walks or when we've had to travel. His affection, attention, and commitment make all the difference. Today we see how happy our dog is when he's with us, and that's priceless. We are very grateful for this partnership built over so many years.

Excellent professional, very attentive and caring with my dogs, I highly recommend him.
🙌🏻 …
A thoughtful and very intentional young man.

There are good professionals, and then there are people who truly make a difference in the lives of our animals. Edmarcelo is one of those people. For many years he has been part of our routine through Matilha Walker and has always shown us great professionalism, dedication, and love for what he does. Our dog has gained quality of life, socialization, and happiness, while we have gained the peace of mind of knowing that he is being cared for by someone who truly cares. We are very grateful for all these years of partnership, trust, and friendship.

Walker Pack came into our lives at a time when we needed help with our dog's routine, and it ended up becoming much more than that. Edmarcelo is a rare person who treats each animal as if it were his own. We have followed his work for years and admire his dedication, honesty, and love for dogs. Our dog is happier, more balanced, and we have the peace of mind of knowing that he is being cared for by someone we truly trust. We wholeheartedly recommend them.

Seriously, I don't even have words to thank him for the care he gives my dog. At first I was hesitant to trust him, because we know how difficult it is to leave our pet with someone else, but it was the best decision I ever made. He always sends detailed feedback, tells me how the walk went, if he ate, if he relieved himself… this makes me feel VERY calm every day. And then there's the affection, right? My dog ​​simply loves him, he gets so excited when he sees it's walk day. You can tell it's not just a job, it's something he does with genuine love. I recommend him without hesitation!

Matilha Walker treats pets with great care and responsibility. You can tell they do it out of love for animals. My dog ​​quickly gained confidence and loved the walks. Excellent and very professional service.

Here at our restaurant in Pinheiros, we highly value working with trustworthy people — and Edmarcelo was a pleasant surprise.
You can easily see the care and dedication he has for the animals. It's not just a walk, it's complete care, with attention, patience, and responsibility.
In addition, he is always very polite, punctual, and fulfills all his commitments, which makes a big difference these days.
He's the type of professional we recommend with confidence, because we know he will deliver excellent work.
Impeccable service! Very careful with my dog, always punctual and attentive. You can tell they truly love animals. My pet came home happy and calm every day. I recommend them without a doubt!

I want to express my special thanks to Matilha Walker for the excellent work they do! 🐾

The care, affection, and professionalism they show the animals make all the difference. My dog, Pantera, is always treated with so much love and attention, and that makes me feel completely calm and confident.

The walks are organized, safe, and clearly done by people who truly love what they do. It's obvious how happy and well-cared-for Pantera is after each outing.

I recommend them without hesitation! Thank you so much for all the care and dedication! 💛🐶
I'm very satisfied with the service! My dog ​​adapted super well and I feel reassured knowing he's in good hands. Excellent communication and great professionalism. ❤️🙂 …

Extremely attentive and committed professional. Always respects schedules and takes very good care of my dog. The difference lies in the affection and communication during walks. I highly recommend him!
He walks my dogs, I really like his job.
